scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c green,blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @veritas/shared watch" "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter backend build" "pnpm --filter frontend build"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter backend start" "pnpm --filter frontend start"
